table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
       custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		 looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty, 
		 itemflatdisc=dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc,
       packqty  = saledetail.packqty,  
       packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
       price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
       itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
		 packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
		 batch = dbo.saledetail.batch,    
		 expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry,    
		 salestax  = saledetail.salestax,
		 rowid     = saledetail.rowid,
	 	 itemname = CASE SaleDetail.Claimable When 'Y' THEN dbo.itempacking.name Else item.name END,
		 itemalias = item.customicode,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name ,
		 address1 = dbo.customer.address1,
		 address2 = dbo.customer.address2,
		 city = dbo.customer.city,
		 phone = dbo.customer.phone, 	
      doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
		
		 invnettotal= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Round(Sum (  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01))) * ( SL.discperc /100), 2)
												 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saledetail SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,   
							 SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)


FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
		 dbo.accounts,
		 dbo.customer

WHERE  dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode=:al_SaleinvCode and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
       dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode
UNION ALL
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, 
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
       custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		 looseqty = sd.looseqty, 
		 itemflatdisc=sd.itemflatdisc,
       packqty  = 0,  
       packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
       price = sd.saleprice,    
       itemdiscperc = sd.discperc,    
		 packunits = sd.packunits,    
		 batch = sd.batch,    
		 expiry = sd.expiry,    
		 salestax  = 0,
		 rowid     = sd.rowid,
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 itemalias = item.customicode,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name ,
		 address1 = dbo.customer.address1,
		 address2 = dbo.customer.address2,
		 city = dbo.customer.city,
		 phone = dbo.customer.phone, 	
      doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
		
		 invnettotal= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SDD.looseqty *  SDD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SDD.looseqty  * ( SDD.saleprice -  SDD.itemflatdisc) * ( SDD.discperc * .01)) + ( SDD.looseqty  *  SDD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Round(Sum (  SDD.looseqty   * ( SDD.saleprice  -  SDD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SDD.discperc * .01))) * ( SL.discperc /100), 2)
												 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			saleinvdetail SDD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SDD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,   
							 SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd, 
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.customer

WHERE
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode=:al_SaleinvCode and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	sd.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
	dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode
table.sort: person A, saleinvcode A, rowid A

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_amount for group 1 ) + sum(misccharges for group 1 distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for group 1 distinct   saleinvcode ), 0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  , 2)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.expression: Sum (( ((  looseqty   *  price  )   - (looseqty * itemflatdisc) )*  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) for group 1 )  *  ( Sum(invdiscperc for group 1 distinct saleinvcode) * .01)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  For Group 1 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 ) ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
